notes:
Fixes from the full review of AniBox, the phone app and CastApp TV.
• A stream that drops halfway keeps your place instead of counting the episode as watched
• The phone's progress comes over every few minutes while AniBox is open, and un-marking by hand on the phone travels too
• Moving files: a file Plex or a player has open is reported instead of copied; too-long paths are named before the move; AniBox no longer closes by itself while files move
• Updates: the zip is checked against the release list, and going back after a failed start also restores your data as it was
